The '''Janissary Corps''' was an elite Astorian military formation used during the [[Bakorian War]].

== Bakorian War Role ==

The corps was used for rapid penetration into Bakorian territory during the opening phase of the war. Astorian doctrine paired Janissary assaults with air support, army-group coordination, and follow-on security by the [[Mobile Defense Forces]].

Old source material names multiple Janissary formations in the Astorian order of battle, but this bridge page does not lock every unit name until a fuller military-order article is written.

== Legacy ==

The success of elite Astorian formations in Bakoria became part of Astoria's military prestige and helped validate the [[Forward Defense Doctrine]].
